sources.quote: > You can access Kimi-K2.5's API on https://platform.moonshot.ai and we provide OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible API for you.
sources.supports: Moonshot's repository confirms that Kimi K2.5 had an official API, but it gives no launch date or price.

sources.quote: > `kimi-k2.5` 已于 **2026 年 8 月 31 日下线**，不再维护和支持。请使用最新模型 [kimi-k3](/docs/guide/kimi-k3-quickstart) ，以获得持续支持和更强推理能力。
sources.supports: The provider's currently extracted model page says Kimi K2.5 was discontinued in August 2026; it does not preserve its earlier price.

notes: The available provider pages do not establish whether the zero values were ever official or state a price effective date, so the classification remains unclear. Internet Archive CDX requests returned empty results or an offline error for the pricing-page URLs, leaving no usable January 2026 snapshot pair.
